title: BBC Learning English from the News 2024 — Quiz 1
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q01_reconstruct
elements.title: The team used old photographs to reconstruct the damaged fountain. What did they do?
choices: Moved it to a new location

elements.name: q02_unmask
elements.title: The investigation unmasked the person behind the fake charity. What did it do?
choices: Asked the person to step down
Hired the person to run the charity

elements.name: q03_millennia
elements.title: The ruins have stood for three millennia. How long is that?

elements.name: q04_stroll
elements.title: Which sentence describes a stroll?
choices: We took a leisurely walk around the garden.
We cycled up a steep hill.
We sprinted to catch a train.
We stood in line outside a shop.
elements.correctAnswer: We took a leisurely walk around the garden.

elements.name: q05_pinpoint
elements.title: The plumber pinpointed the source of the leak. What did the plumber do?
choices: Repaired every pipe in the building
Measured the amount of water lost

elements.name: q06_walk_away_from_someone_or_something
elements.title: After weeks of unproductive talks, they decided to walk away from the deal. What did they do?
choices: Moved the talks to a different location
Asked for more time to decide

elements.name: q07_oust
elements.title: The board voted to oust its chair. What did it vote to do?
choices: Remove the chair from the position
Let the chair choose a successor
elements.correctAnswer: Remove the chair from the position

elements.name: q08_seismic
elements.title: The court's ruling caused a seismic shift in how the industry worked. What does “seismic” suggest here?
choices: The change affected just one worker.
The change was expected to reverse immediately.

elements.name: q09_get_someone_or_something_wrong
elements.title: “I got your message wrong. I thought you wanted to cancel the meeting.” What does the speaker admit?
choices: Reporting the message to a manager

elements.name: q10_tainted
elements.title: The shop recalled juice that was tainted with bacteria. What does “tainted” mean here?
